questions.q: Which three built-in actions cover the overwhelming majority of real flows, per this lesson?
options: Create Record, Update Record, and a notification action
For Each, If/Else, and Create Record
REST Step, Script Step, and Subflow
Trigger, Condition, and Loop
questions.explain: Most flows are built almost entirely from these three actions before anything more advanced is needed.

questions.q: What does the Create Record action always do?
options: Inserts a brand-new record on a chosen table
Modifies the record that triggered the flow
Sends an email using an existing Notification
Pauses the flow until a human responds
questions.explain: Create Record always produces a new row; changing an existing record is Update Record's job instead.

questions.q: A flow is triggered on Incident update and needs to set a field on that same Incident. Which action fits, and why?
options: Update Record, because the triggering record is already available as a data pill to modify
Create Record, because every action should make a new record
A notification action, because notifications can edit fields
None — Flow Designer cannot modify the triggering record
questions.explain: Update Record modifies an existing record, most commonly the trigger record itself, using the same data-pill field mapping as Create Record.

questions.q: How does Flow Designer's notification-style action relate to the Notification mechanism covered in Course 3 of this path?
options: It fires an existing Notification (or sends a direct message) as a flow step, reusing that existing infrastructure
It replaces the Notification mechanism entirely with a new system
It has no relationship — flows cannot trigger Notifications
It requires rebuilding every Notification from scratch inside the flow
questions.explain: Flow Designer builds on top of the admin-configured Notification system rather than replacing it.

questions.q: In the example flow (Asset Request submitted → fulfillment record → status update → confirmation email), what does Update Record do?
options: Marks the original submission as "In Progress"
Creates the fulfillment team's request record
Sends the confirmation email to the requester
Fires the Record trigger that starts the flow
questions.explain: Update Record changes the already-existing submission's status; Create Record made the new fulfillment record, and the notification action sent the email.
